title: Deliver the Figma plugin through an HttpOnly loopback session
goal: The approved compact Dresser plugin loads its built UI from the companion's fixed /plugin origin, authenticates capabilities and render with an ephemeral HttpOnly session cookie, and completes the selected-Frame-to-beside-source PNG flow without exposing or persisting the bearer token.

delivery.user_value: A designer can run the approved local Figma plugin demo without copying, embedding, exposing, or persisting the companion bearer token.

steps: Run the documented local development command, import the real-ID manifest, and open the plugin; the inline bootstrap navigates to http://127.0.0.1:4783/plugin and establishes an HttpOnly session.
Select one Frame, configure an exact Dresser preview through same-origin capabilities/render calls, and verify no bearer appears in any built artifact, URL, message, storage, or log.
Insert the fresh PNG 80 px beside the unchanged source Frame and confirm the session becomes invalid after companion restart.

work_classification.reason: The user-approved recommended visual contract freezes selection, hierarchy, states, defaults, validation, recovery, and insertion; R1 adds only the missing authentication handoff and implements that frozen flow.

local.reason: The approved development plugin and its single remediation are local-only with no external tracker, Community publication, deployment, or push.

reasons: Expands the local bridge and plugin boundary to establish browser session authentication for user image bytes; failure could expose a secret or permit cross-origin rendering, so independent security preflight and negative-path verification are release gates.

out: Existing bearer-token semantics for opaque-origin tests and non-plugin local clients, including Host/origin/token/CORS validation and /v1/shutdown bearer-only behavior
dresser-preset/v1, BrowserSessionManager, server/mockup-mcp, .local/dresser-mirror, MANIFEST.sha256, Chrome/CDP rendering, and existing MCP artifacts

Approved TASK-DRESSER-FIGMA-002 visual hierarchy, dimensions, responsive rules, states, copy, icon strategy, capability controls, preview freshness, image bounds, naming, placement, and source-preservation criteria
batch/multi-frame, video, editable/vector output, preset persistence, analytics, cloud or remote rendering, public transport, and any production authentication system

Figma Community publication, plugin review/marketing assets, deployment, Git push, force-push, merge, tag, release, generated portfolio dist, portfolio source, tasks/HISTORY.md, source evidence, and unrelated dirty-worktree changes

constraints: Serve only the fully built self-contained plugin UI at exact GET /plugin on BRIDGE_ORIGIN; reject query strings, traversal, alternate static paths, wrong methods, Host values, and missing build output. Use no-store, nosniff, a restrictive self-only CSP/frame policy compatible with Figma Desktop, and no external script, style, font, image, or network dependency.

Keep manifest ui as a minimal inline bootstrap whose only runtime behavior is figma.showUI(__html__, { width: 360, height: 640, themeColors: true }) followed by navigation to http://127.0.0.1:4783/plugin. The bootstrap contains no bearer, session ID, screenshot, preset, local path, or mutable runtime state.

On a valid /plugin document request, generate a cryptographically random opaque session ID, store only its hash and bounded expiry in companion memory, and set it only as a __Host-prefixed HttpOnly Secure SameSite=None Path=/ cookie needed by the embedded non-null-origin iframe. Do not serialize it to runtime.json, files, build output, URLs, DOM, JavaScript, pluginMessage, clientStorage, local/session storage, IndexedDB, service workers, console, or logs.

Prove the exact cookie attributes work in Figma Desktop's embedded loopback iframe. If that environment rejects Secure loopback or third-party session cookies, return BLOCKED; do not weaken HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite, Host binding, origin checks, or fall back to bearer exposure/persistence.

Cookie sessions authorize only same-origin /v1/capabilities and /v1/render requests carrying a fixed non-secret plugin-client header and browser fetch metadata consistent with same-origin UI. They never authorize /v1/shutdown, /plugin issuance, arbitrary routes, opaque/null-origin requests, navigations, or requests with absent/conflicting origin metadata.

Require one unambiguous authentication mode per request: existing Bearer plus Origin:null follows the verified legacy path unchanged; session cookie plus exact BRIDGE_ORIGIN follows the plugin path without CORS response headers; reject requests containing both, wrong/expired/unknown cookies, cross-origin Origin/Referer/fetch metadata, or missing client marker before manager mutation.

Bound session lifetime and count, rotate on fresh plugin load, remove expired sessions, clear all sessions on stop/restart, and send an expired Max-Age=0 cookie on invalidation where a response is possible. A companion restart must invalidate every previously issued cookie even if the browser retains its opaque value.

The served non-null-origin UI must post to the Figma parent using the actual local development plugin ID and https://www.figma.com target origin, accept messages only from the expected Figma parent and typed schema, and keep that non-secret ID in the ignored development manifest/build configuration without inventing a Community ID.

Preserve the full approved TASK-DRESSER-FIGMA-002 UI and canvas contract: one bounded selected Frame, every live PNG capability, exact initial/stale/refreshed preview, latest-preset insertion, 4096 px limits, one named image rectangle at source absolute x + width + 80/y, selected result, unchanged source/parent/unrelated nodes, all recoverable negatives, and one undoable action.

Reuse @phosphor-icons/react with direct named imports, typed Question fallback, accessible names, and the approved 360x640/420x720 light/dark visual contract. Mobbin remains explicitly waived; do not alter the approved concept or introduce new UX decisions.

The development command must build bootstrap/main/served UI, start the verified fixed-port companion, and provide import instructions without printing secrets. Production networkAccess remains ['none']; only the exact fixed loopback origin is a development allowance.

Preserve the R1 route-specific preflight and truly-empty shutdown-body fixes, bridge redaction/cleanup/BUSY semantics, all MCP/mirror behavior, and unrelated dirty-worktree files. Do not publish, deploy, push, merge, tag, release, or edit generated portfolio dist.
acceptance_criteria: The one-command local development path builds a sandbox-safe main, minimal secret-free bootstrap, and self-contained served UI; a real-ID manifest imports without error, /plugin opens at the approved 360x640 theme, and the companion issues a working ephemeral HttpOnly Secure SameSite session without exposing the bearer.

With exactly one selected Frame, the main thread exports a proportional PNG bounded to 4096 px, the non-null-origin UI receives only typed Uint8Array/context data, and authenticated same-origin capabilities load every current PNG-relevant device/color/background/picture/mesh/layout option and exact defaults.

The approved compact panel, 420x720 expansion, conditional controls, light/dark variables, keyboard/focus/labels/status states, named Phosphor icons, Question fallback, and reduced-motion behavior match the approved TASK-DRESSER-FIGMA-002 visual contract without new UX decisions.

Initial, manually refreshed, and pre-insert previews are exact browser-exported Dresser PNG bytes; setting changes mark preview stale, Insert renders first when stale, and the displayed final preview, returned metadata, and inserted bytes/dimensions agree.

Insert creates exactly one image-filled rectangle named 'Dresser — <source frame name>' at the rendered dimensions and source absolute x + width + 80/y on the current page, selects it, is undoable, and leaves the source Frame, its parent, and every unrelated node unchanged.

Empty/multiple/non-Frame/removed/changed selection, stale or malformed messages, offline bridge, expired/restarted/ambiguous session, legacy bad bearer, BUSY, timeout, invalid capability/PNG/metadata, oversized image, duplicate insert, and Figma mutation failure are recoverable and create no partial or misplaced node.

Session issuance and use are same-origin and bounded: cross-origin or null-origin cookie attempts, CSRF-like requests, missing client marker, navigation, wrong route, mixed auth, expired/unknown/replayed cookie, and post-restart cookie each fail before manager/shutdown mutation with no permissive CORS reflection.

No bearer or session value appears in bootstrap/main/ui bundles, manifest, URLs/query/hash, DOM, messages, browser/client storage, service worker/cache, runtime.json, stdout/stderr, errors, evidence, or Git; only cookie hashes live in process memory and all disappear on stop/restart.

The existing bearer path remains byte-for-contract compatible for authenticated capabilities/render/shutdown tests and other local clients, including opaque Origin:null CORS, while session cookies cannot invoke shutdown and all R1 preflight/body protections remain intact.

Plugin, bridge, security, selected-frame, visual/accessibility, MCP, mirror, cleanup, and scoped-diff verification pass with no Community publication, deployment, remote delivery, portfolio change, mirror/MCP contract change, or unrelated dirty-worktree mutation.

commands.command: node --test --test-name-pattern='plugin session|same-origin plugin UI|restart invalidation|selected Frame' server/figma-plugin-bridge/tests/*.test.mjs figma-plugin/tests/*.test.*

checks.description: In Figma Desktop, inspect /plugin response/cookie attributes, same-origin capabilities/render, expiry, fresh-load rotation, stop/restart invalidation, legacy bearer parity, cookie denial on shutdown, and cross/null-origin, missing-marker, mixed-auth, navigation, replay, and CSRF-like negatives with zero manager side effect.

Run the approved real-Figma demo from one disposable top-level Frame through exact capabilities, representative device/background/layout changes, stale/update/insert, and record matching preview/result bytes, name, dimensions, 80 px placement, selected result, one undo, and unchanged source/unrelated nodes.

Reconcile all visible options with live dresser-preset/v1 and compare exact preview/insert output for representative phone, tablet, browser/none, solid, mesh, picture, transparent, ratio, scale, and position states at approved panel sizes/themes without stale preset or unsupported UI.

Scan built files, manifest, URLs, DOM, messages, all browser storage/cache, runtime state, process memory diagnostics, logs, errors, evidence, and Git diff for bearer/session leakage; verify process-only hashed sessions, cleanup, source privacy, four-task security scope, bearer/preflight/shutdown parity, MCP/mirror integrity, and no external or unrelated change.
Exercise an unknown icon key and verify direct named Phosphor imports, typed Question fallback, development/test-only diagnostic, and no empty box, emoji, glyph placeholder, or full-catalog bundle.

At approved 360x640 and 420x720 light/dark states, keyboard through every control and verify accessible icon names, consistent geometry, visible focus, labels/status announcements, disabled/loading/error/success behavior, reduced motion, and no clipping.

steps: Stop only the task-owned companion, invalidate and clear its in-memory sessions, expire the plugin cookie where possible, remove only ignored local plugin/runtime state, and undo/delete only the disposable verification result node.

Revert only TASK-DRESSER-FIGMA-002-R1 changes under server/figma-plugin-bridge, figma-plugin, package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, and .gitignore; rerun TASK-DRESSER-FIGMA-001-R1 bridge/preflight/shutdown checks plus MCP and mirror regressions.
data_recovery: No persistent user data or migration exists; sessions are ephemeral process memory, the source Frame is unchanged, and the single inserted image node is undoable.
